title: Amyloid and aging reshape glial waste management in APP/PS1 mice
task: Characterizing age and amyloid-dependent changes in brain waste management structures
key_results: PAS-positive granules increased with age and amyloid pathology; extraparenchymal IgM+ granules declined with age; IgM+ astrocytes increased robustly with aging and more abundant in APP/PS1 mice
comments: The shift from early extraparenchymal to late intracellular waste handling is intriguing, but causality between structural remodeling and cognitive decline remains unestablished.

model_io.model: APPswe/PS1dE9 transgenic mice and C57BL/6 controls (female)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Aging increases intracellular waste sequestration in the brain
hypotheses.result: PAS granules increased markedly with age, particularly in hippocampus and piriform cortex

hypotheses.hypothesis: Amyloid pathology enhances glial waste-handling responses
hypotheses.result: IgM+ astrocytes consistently more abundant in APP/PS1 mice; co-express complement C3 indicating complement-engaged reactive phenotype

title: Specific targeting of cancer cell mitochondria with a malaria drug improves pancreatic cancer outcome
task: Targeting pancreatic cancer mitochondria with artemisinin conjugate
key_results: DZ-ART1 accumulated 5-10 fold more in cancer vs. normal cells; suppressed tumor growth and prolonged survival in KPC transgenic, syngeneic, and PDX models without normal tissue toxicity
comments: The mitochondria-dependent mechanism is elegant, but translation to human PDAC requires phase I clinical validation given the modest selectivity window.

model_io.model: KPC transgenic, syngeneic, and patient-derived xenograft (PDX) mouse models

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mitochondrial targeting with DZ-ART1 disrupts cancer cell bioenergetics
hypotheses.result: Mitochondrial depletion decreased DZ-ART1 uptake and cytotoxicity, confirming mitochondria-dependent action
Increased lethal effect of chemotherapies in vitro and in vivo

title: Safe MES-driven execution control for advanced manufacturing systems using constrained matrix zonotopes
task: Filter unsafe manufacturing execution commands using constrained matrix zonotopes
key_results: Empirical physical-safety rate 0.985, semantic violation rate 0.058, recovery time 23.6±6.1 s on 6,427 station-level decisions; hybrid semantic–physical approach balances competing safety metrics
comments: Real-world field replay validation is strong, but the trade-off between physical safety and semantic compliance is metric-dependent, suggesting no universally optimal configuration.

model_io.model: Constrained matrix zonotope (CMZ) filter with semantic module
inputs: MES rules (finite Boolean combinations of linear predicates)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Projection-based CMZ filtering with semantic modules reduces semantic violations and manual intervention relative to pure CMZ
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reduced semantic violations, manual intervention and recovery time at slight cost to empirical physical-safety metrics

title: Self-evolving multimodal digital twin for health-aware and safety-aware intelligence in electric vehicle lithium-ion batteries
task: Estimate EV lithium-ion battery state and detect faults via self-evolving multimodal digital twin
key_results: Simulation RMSE: SOC 0.0525, core temperature 0.4049 K, capacity 234.92 C, ohmic resistance 0.01078 Ω; anomaly detection F1-score 0.8716; aging validation RMSE: voltage 0.081 V, SOC 0.0297, SOH 0.0231
comments: Integration of impedance-derived sensing with Unscented Kalman Filter and self-evolving trust allocation is thorough, but validation limited to simulation and lab aging data without in-vehicle field testing.

model_io.model: Self-evolving multimodal digital twin (UKF + dual-network electrical/thermal models + health-evolution rules + anomaly accumulation layer)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Impedance-derived measurement channel improves estimation accuracy over voltage/current/temperature alone
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; self-evolving trust-allocation strategy dynamically redistributes confidence based on innovation consistency

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bounded process-noise inflation enhances estimator adaptability under persistent model–measurement mismatch
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; framework maintains low RMSE across simulation and aging validation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hierarchical anomaly/thermal-risk accumulation enables fault-oriented safety decisions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; detection accuracy 0.9017, recall 1.0, F1-score 0.8716 on simulated faults

title: Dynamic heterogeneous graph-structured knowledge tracing with multi-behavior integration and temporal forgetting
task: Estimate learner knowledge evolution from multi-behavior events (video, exercise, comments) in online courses
key_results: DHGKT-Core achieves test AUC 0.8529 vs. 0.8318 for exercise-only variant and 0.7508 for unstructured multi-behavior fusion; video contribution is course-dependent (improvement in 3/4 courses)
comments: The finding that graph-topology aggregation variants yield negligible AUC gains suggests the principal value lies in transparent event-driven decay rather than learned graph structure, limiting the contribution's novelty.

inputs: learner events (video watch, exercise attempt, comments)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exponential temporal decay applied before each event improves state estimation over exercise-only baselines
Video-behavior exposure signal is universally beneficial across courses
hypotheses.result: Refuted; video improved 3 courses but reduced performance on C_801420

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learnable topology-aggregation and semantic/social extensions provide reliable gains
hypotheses.result: Refuted; negligible AUC changes across variants

title: A simulation study on the effect of bifurcation angles on the temperature characteristics in bifurcated tunnel fires
task: Quantify bifurcation angle effects on ceiling temperature and decay in tunnel fires
key_results: Empirical model ΔTmax/T0 = (5.855 + 1.921sinθ)Q*2/3 validated across 30°–90° angles and 5–30 MW; temperature decay follows double-exponential model with angle-dependent decay parameters
comments: High-fidelity FDS simulations provide practical fire-safety tools, but the empirical model's generalization to untested angles and fire types remains uncertain.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Classic dimensionless relationship ΔTmax/T0 ∝ kQ*2/3 remains valid with geometry-dependent proportionality constant
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; k varies with bifurcation angle as (5.855 + 1.921sinθ)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temperature decay in main tunnel follows exponential model; branch tunnel decay is modulated by bifurcation angle
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; double-exponential model fits main tunnel; branch tunnel decay parameters are sinθ-dependent

title: Biomechanically-constrained generative adversarial networks for motion skill simulation and error correction in virtual training systems
task: Generate biomechanically plausible motor-skill corrections via constrained GANs for virtual training
key_results: Constraint-aware GAN identifies technique faults with 89.4% accuracy; reduces injury-weighted violation-severity by 76% vs. vanilla GAN; post-feedback trials rated 23.7% higher by coaches
comments: Strong empirical validation on three sports skills, but lack of a concurrent control group for within-session improvements limits causal inference strength.

model_io.model: Biomechanically-constrained GAN with dual-pathway discriminator and hierarchical error detection
inputs: motion-capture sequences (45 participants; basketball free throws, squats, jumps)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dual-pathway discriminator (perceptual + biomechanical correctness) enforces physiological plausibility during generation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; constraint-aware model reduces frame-wise violation rate from 18.7% to 2.7% vs. vanilla GAN

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hierarchical error-detection module improves fault identification and feedback tailoring
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; post-feedback trials rated 23.7% higher by blind expert coaches

title: A reproducible evaluation framework for benchmarking machine learning and hybrid ensemble models in power system anomaly detection
task: Benchmark ML and hybrid ensemble models for power-system anomaly detection with interpretability
key_results: Stacking Hybrid achieves 0.9994 accuracy; Gradient Boosting reaches 0.9962; hybrid models outperform single classifiers; SHAP and LIME provide instance- and global-level feature importance
comments: All models achieve near-ceiling accuracy (>0.99), raising questions about dataset difficulty and the practical relevance of marginal performance differences.

model_io.model: Random Forest, Logistic Regression, SVM-RBF, KNN, Gradient Boosting, Voting Hybrid, Stacking Hybrid
inputs: voltage, current, load, frequency, power factor, THD measurements

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid ensemble methods (Voting, Stacking) outperform individual classifiers
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Stacking Hybrid 0.9994 vs. best single model (Gradient Boosting) 0.9962

hypotheses.hypothesis: Models detect both abrupt anomalies (cyber spikes, voltage sags) and subtle drift patterns
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; framework handles both abrupt and gradual anomalies

title: Microwave metamaterial sensor for label-free dielectric characterization of biological equivalent media
task: Design and validate a microwave metamaterial biosensor for label-free refractive index sensing of biological media
key_results: Sensitivity of 600 MHz/RIU, quality factor of 22.46, figure of merit of 5.34 at 2.1 GHz resonance frequency; validated for blood and hemoglobin-equivalent dielectric properties
comments: Promising compact platform with strong field localization, but limited to microwave frequencies; actual biological fluid measurements and comparison with established techniques remain absent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electromagnetic field confinement in rectangular resonators enhances field–matter interaction and refractive index sensitivity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; optimized geometry achieves 600 MHz/RIU sensitivity with stable resonance under variable material loading
